description: Natural Hazards Research Summit: Surrogate Models of Highway Bridges for Regional-Scale Simulations of Transportation Networks is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Gregory Deierlein, Stanford University (stanford.edu). This poster outlines the process of developing a surrogate model for structure-specific, site-specific assessments of highway bridge columns under seismic loading. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-qmxy-yp38. Keywords: Surrogate Model, Regional Assessment, Bridge. Published 2024-06-12. Facility named: SimCenter. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
